news_headlines.title: Why hybrid cloud is becoming the default for AI
news_headlines.summary: This article argues that hybrid cloud is becoming a structural necessity for AI workloads, not just a transitional phase. It highlights how AI's unique demands regarding latency for correctness, distributed governance, and specific cost dynamics (cost gravity) make a single, centralized environment unfeasible. The author advocates for a constraint-centric architectural approach, where systems are designed to operate across environments by default to satisfy these competing demands.
